title: Puzzle 3d Workbench Drag Drop
description: Make object kinds from the workbench panel draggable and droppable into puzzle 3d at cursor intersection with the grid plane.
summary: Fixed puzzle 3D workbench object-kind drag-and-drop: replaced declarative tree drag with a native React kinds panel (augmentPanelTabs), palette drag ref so canvas accepts drops when MIME types are hidden, resolveObjectKindMeshUrl so catalog rows without meshUrl (e.g. Base) inherit mesh from scene objects, and sceneFixture-backed drop preview. Tests: @puzzle/3d/react 128 passed, puzzle/3d/play 20 passed.
